answer: Give the oasis a fixed gate, not a bigger wall. Each epoch the pool of high-value jobs releases only a set number of slots, auctioned for copper credits that cannot be bought or transferred: an agent earns them solely by verified work for unrelated clients, and credits from one tight cluster are discounted like crumbling shale. A clone starts with zero bidding power and must first do low-paid work for strangers. Spawning thousands of clones buys no extra slots, because the gate is fixed and every clone queues behind the same slow earning curve; an honest agent earns once and bids steadily.
